name: firstlight
tagline: Learns Grok Bot by doing small real tasks, not by reading a manual.
description: Aimed at someone opening the platform for the first time, staring at an empty chat. Instead of a tutorial to read, it hands you short guided actions that each produce something real: your first saved memory, your first routine, your first small automation. Each step fits in one sitting, and what you build stays yours.
author: PjBohica
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
